This repository is for maintaining a checklist of the butterflies of Alaska in Darwin Core format based on the *Butterflies of Alaska* [@PhilipFerris2026].

The structure of the checklist follows guidance of @GBIF2017. The `archive/taxon.csv` table follows the format of the [Darwin Core taxon extension](https://rs.gbif.org/core/dwc_taxon_2025-07-10.xml). Terms and controlled vocabularies follow @DarwinCoreMaintenanceGroup2026.
